title: The Traitors Telugu Trailer Out
excerpt: Teja Sajja hosts Prime Video's Telugu adaptation of the global reality franchise — 10 episodes from Oct 15.
body:
• The trailer for The Traitors Telugu dropped on October 6, 2026.
  • Host: Teja Sajja (Hanu-Man, Mirai) — his reality-show hosting debut.
  • Premieres: October 15, 2026 on Prime Video — 10 episodes over four weeks, new episodes every Thursday at 12 noon IST.
  • Format: 20 celebrity contestants; hidden Traitors eliminate Innocents each night while everyone builds a shared prize pool.
  • Produced by: SOL Productions (Kamna Menezes, Fazila Allana).

Prime Video has released the official trailer for The Traitors Telugu, the Telugu adaptation of the global reality franchise, premiering October 15, 2026.

About the show

Hosted by actor Teja Sajja — the Hanu-Man and Mirai star making his debut as a reality-show host — the 10-episode series brings together 20 celebrity contestants for a high-stakes game of trust, strategy, and betrayal. Episodes stream in Telugu with English subtitles, so diaspora audiences can follow along worldwide on Prime Video.

The premise is simple and ruthless: contestants are secretly divided into Innocents and Traitors. While the Innocents must unmask the Traitors hiding among them, the Traitors manipulate their fellow players, stay undetected, and eliminate an opponent each night — even as the whole group works together to build the prize pool. If any Traitors survive to the end, they take the entire prize.

Why it is worth watching

The format began in the Netherlands as De Verraders and has since been adapted in more than 30 countries, becoming one of the world's fastest-growing reality franchises. The Telugu edition follows two successful Hindi seasons on Prime Video; producer SOL Productions says the adaptation keeps the franchise's themes of trust, ambition, and betrayal while giving it a distinctly Telugu flavour.

For Teja Sajja, the show is a new avatar between theatrical outings — he is riding the commercial success of Hanu-Man and Mirai, with Zombie Reddy 2 – NXT LVL awaited. His tagline for the season: "Trust is uncool, deception is the new rule here."
